JP2001A.fake: Four correct 2000–01 hits are followed by twelve 1945–49 occupation-era songs, with nothing at all from 1950–1999, so it sounds like two unrelated playlists glued together.
JP2001A.missingScene: avex/Hamasaki and Komuro-era dance pop, Hello! Project idols, Johnny's (SMAP, KinKi Kids), visual-kei and band boom (GLAY, L'Arc), R&B wave (MISIA, Chemistry), anime songs, and the whole 1950s–90s kayokyoku/enka/new music/idol canon. I am unsure only of exactly how known 東京ブギウギ and 青い山脈 were to a 2001 teenager (TV natsumero specials).
